# WASS2SHydroR

WASS2SHydroR is an R package for seasonal and sub-seasonal hydrological
forecasting in West Africa and the Sahel. It provides tools to download
climate data, prepare gridded NetCDF inputs, train statistical and
machine learning models, combine multi-product predictions, evaluate
hydrological skill, and run HYPE scenarios.

The package documentation website can be built with:

``` r
pkgdown::build_site()
```

The generated site is written to `docs/`.

## Installation

Install the development version from the `staging` branch on GitHub:

``` r
install.packages("remotes")

remotes::install_github(
  "kiema97/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR",
  ref = "staging",
  build_vignettes = FALSE,
  upgrade = "never",
  dependencies = c("Depends", "Imports", "LinkingTo")
)
```

This installs the package and its core dependencies without rebuilding
the vignettes or upgrading packages already installed in your R library.

For a fuller installation including optional packages used by CDS
access, NetCDF processing, mapping, parallel execution, and additional
ML engines, use:

``` r
remotes::install_github(
  "kiema97/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR",
  ref = "staging",
  build_vignettes = FALSE,
  upgrade = "never",
  dependencies = TRUE
)
```

For local package development from a clone, run
[`renv::restore()`](https://rstudio.github.io/renv/reference/restore.html)
from the package root, then use `pkgload::load_all(".")` while editing
the source.

## Quick Start

``` r
library(WASS2SHydroR)

data_by_product <- make_toy_data_by_product()
basin_id <- unique(data_by_product[[1]]$HYBAS_ID)[1]

res <- wass2s_run_basin_mods_stat(
  basin_id = basin_id,
  data_by_product = data_by_product,
  fusion_method = "median",
  quiet = FALSE
)

res$scores
```

See the website articles for the complete CDS, data preparation,
statistical, machine learning, and HYPE workflows.

## Implemented ML Models

The ML model registry currently supports:

``` r
c("rf", "xgb", "mlp", "kknn", "svmlinear", "mars", "cubist", "glmnet")
```

The final/product meta-fuser registry currently supports:

``` r
c("rf", "xgb", "glmnet", "kknn", "svmlinear", "mars", "cubist", "mlp")
```

# Package index

## Data Acquisition and Preparation

- [`wass2s_download_cds()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_download_cds.md)
  : Robust Parallel Downloader for CDS/ECMWF (via ecmwfr) with Year
  Chunking
- [`wass2s_prepare_data()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_prepare_data.md)
  : Prepare gridded hydro-climatic data from NetCDF or stars objects
- [`make_toy_data_by_product()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/make_toy_data_by_product.md)
  : Create synthetic multi-product hydrological dataset

## Statistical Forecasting

- [`wass2s_tune_pred_stat()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_tune_pred_stat.md)
  : Tune and refit a single product/model, select configuration by KGE
- [`wass2s_cons_mods_stat()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_cons_mods_stat.md)
  : Consolidate predictions across products for one statistical model
- [`wass2s_run_basin_mods_stat()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_run_basin_mods_stat.md)
  : Run basin-level statistical model consolidation and fusion
- [`wass2s_run_basins_stat()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_run_basins_stat.md)
  : Run the statistical method across multiple basins
- [`wass2s_run_pipeline_stat()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_run_pipeline_stat.md)
  : Wrapper function called by the core (run_method) for statistical
  pipeline

## Machine Learning Forecasting

- [`wass2s_tune_pred_ml()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_tune_pred_ml.md)
  : Tune and predict for one product and one ML model
- [`wass2s_cons_mods_ml()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_cons_mods_ml.md)
  : Consolidate top-K products for one basin and one ML model
- [`wass2s_run_bas_mod_ml()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_run_bas_mod_ml.md)
  : Run basin-level machine learning model consolidation and final
  fusion
- [`wass2s_run_basins_ml()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_run_basins_ml.md)
  : Run the Hydro + ML pipeline for all basins
- [`wass2s_run_pipeline_hydro()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_run_pipeline_hydro.md)
  : Wrapper function called by the core (run_method) for hydro (ML)
  pipeline

## HYPE Execution

- [`wass2s_hype_run()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_hype_run.md)
  : Run HYPE in a given directory (non-GUI mode)
- [`wass2s_hype_run_watchlog()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_hype_run_watchlog.md)
  : Run HYPE in "watch-log" mode (Windows GUI executables)
- [`wass2s_hype_run_batch()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_hype_run_batch.md)
  : Run multiple HYPE scenarios (one directory each)
- [`wass2s_hype_run_one_model()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_hype_run_one_model.md)
  : Run one model workflow: prepare OBS -\> update info.txt resultdir
  -\> run HYPE
- [`wass2s_hype_run_all_models()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_hype_run_all_models.md)
  : Run the full workflow for all models discovered in a forcing
  directory
- [`wass2s_detect_high_flow_periods()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_detect_high_flow_periods.md)
  : Detect high-flow periods from daily discharge time series

## Metrics and Diagnostics

- [`wass2s_kge()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_kge.md)
  : Kling-Gupta Efficiency (vector form)
- [`wass2s_rmse()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_rmse.md)
  : Root Mean Squared Error (vector)
- [`wass2s_mae()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_mae.md)
  : Mean Absolute Error (vector)
- [`wass2s_nse()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_nse.md)
  : Nash–Sutcliffe Efficiency (vector)
- [`wass2s_corr()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_corr.md)
  : Pearson Correlation Coefficient (vector form)
- [`wass2s_minmax()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_minmax.md)
  : Min–max normalization to a target range
- [`wass2s_rolling_cv()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_rolling_cv.md)
  [`make_rolling()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_rolling_cv.md)
  : Robust rolling-origin CV with target number of splits

## Forecast Classes and Maps

- [`wass2s_class_from_forecast()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_class_from_forecast.md)
  : From forecast to class probabilities (Q1/Q3 classes by default)
- [`wass2s_class_entropy()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_class_entropy.md)
  : Compute entropy of class probabilities (uncertainty indicator)
- [`wass2s_plot_map()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/wass2s_plot_map.md)
  : Generic map plotter for WASS2S products (probabilities, class,
  metrics)

## Generic Interface

- [`run_wass2s()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/run_wass2s.md)
  : High-level runner for WASS2S
- [`run_method(`*`<method_hydro>`*`)`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/run_method.method_hydro.md)
  : S3 entrypoint for method "hydro"
- [`list_methods()`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/list_methods.md)
  : List available forecasting methods
- [`hf_registry`](https://kiema97.github.io/AGRHYMET-WASS2SHydroR/reference/hf_registry.md)
  : Registry of available forecasting methods
